neighbours.label: 'and' inside a fixed binomial of function words or adverbs (if and only if, in and of itself, unless and until, each and every, here and there), as against 'and' joining ordinary nouns, verbs or clauses
fire: The function returns true if and only if the list is empty.
Payments will be held unless and until the contract is signed.
The idea is not harmful in and of itself, but it can be misused.
Each and every guest received a small gift at the door.
We saw a few deer here and there along the forest road.
The festival takes place in and around the old harbour.
The magazine is written by and for retired teachers.
Prices rose again and again during the long winter.
quiet: The function returns true when the list has no items in it.
Payments will be held until the contract has been signed.
The idea is not harmful by itself, but it can be misused.
Every guest received a small gift and a card at the door.
We saw a few deer and a fox along the forest road.
The festival takes place near the old harbour and the market.
The magazine is written for retired teachers and their families.
Prices rose and wages fell during the long winter.
